parsed.conclusion: On successful pre-stop observation followed by a failed post-stop observation, old identities are treated as fresh survivors and their PIDs are passed to taskkill. A PID reused after session.stop can address an unrelated process. No current ownership proof is required on this failure branch.
parsed.limits: The unsafe selection and kill call are independently verified in source/artifacts. No actual PID reuse or unrelated process termination was induced. This is not a claim that production has already killed a bystander.
